sn8.12:1.1: On one occasion the Venerable Vaṅgīsa was dwelling at Sāvatthī in Jeta’s Grove, Anāthapiṇḍika’s Park.
sn8.12:1.2: Now on that occasion the Venerable Vaṅgīsa had only recently attained arahantship and, while experiencing the happiness of liberation, on that occasion he recited these verses:
sn8.12:2.1: Drunk on poetry, I used to wander
sn8.12:2.2: From village to village, town to town.
sn8.12:2.3: Then I saw the Enlightened One
sn8.12:3.1: He then taught me the Dhamma:
sn8.12:3.3: Having heard the Dhamma from him,
sn8.12:4.1: Indeed, for the good of many,
sn8.12:4.4: Who have reached and seen the fixed course.
sn8.12:5.1: Welcome indeed has it been for me,
sn8.12:5.2: My coming into the Buddha’s presence.
sn8.12:5.3: The three knowledges have been obtained,
sn8.12:5.4: The Buddha’s Teaching has been done.
sn8.12:6.1: I know now my past abodes,
sn8.12:6.3: A triple knowledge man, attained to spiritual powers,
sn8.12:6.4: I am skilled in the course of others’ minds.
